bullets.text: Elara keeps Hindalco Buy but cuts SOTP target to Rs1,227 from Rs1,270 (28% upside); copper EBITDA hit record Rs16.7bn, normalising at Rs12-13bn a quarter.
bullets.source: Elara — Metals & Mining - Hindalco Industries - Copper business – Guidance raised - Q2FY27 Update - Buy - TP: INR 1,227

detail.summary: Q2 consolidated EBITDA of about Rs128bn beat on $39mn Oswego insurance proceeds and strong copper. Target cut reflects lower LME aluminium and a roll to Sep-2028. Management says Novelis leverage has peaked and free cash flow turns positive by FY27-end.
points: Copper EBITDA Rs16.7bn, +164% YoY vs ~Rs9.0bn guidance
~Rs3.5bn of copper EBITDA non-recurring
Novelis net leverage 4.7x vs 3.4x a year ago
EBITDA estimates cut ~2% FY27E, ~3% FY28-29E
SOTP: Novelis 5.5x, other businesses 6.0x

bullets.text: Emkay holds Hindalco ADD, target Rs1,150 (20% upside); adjusted EBITDA Rs128.1bn beat consensus by 11.2%, FY27E EBITDA raised 5.9%.
bullets.source: Emkay — Hindalco: Strong India performance drives EBITDA beat; ADD; Target: Rs1,150

detail.summary: Beat came from India upstream aluminium and copper, with higher export premiums and VAP pricing offsetting lower LME. Management flags about 5% sequential input-cost inflation in Q3 from coal and CP coke, partly hedged. Novelis recovery is expected to continue with Bay Minette commissioning in Q4.
points: Upstream Al EBITDA Rs70.1bn, 18.2% above Emkay
India Al EBITDA/t $2,125 vs $2,331 in Q1
Copper EBITDA Rs16.7bn, +82.2% QoQ; Q3 run-rate ~Rs12bn
Novelis adj EBITDA $508mn, in line
Consol net debt Rs804bn, 1.8x EBITDA

bullets.text: Ambit stays SELL on Hindalco: Novelis ex-insurance EBITDA $469mn, net debt $8.5bn, and Bay Minette adds little EBITDA in FY28 (+8 more in Outlook).
bullets.source: Ambit — Ambit Metals: Hindalco (SELL) - Novelis -Balance-sheet repair takes Longer

detail.summary: Novelis' Q2 was flattered by insurance, with strike and tariff drags underneath. Q3 stays seasonally weak, and Bay Minette will ship mostly beverage cans in FY28, so earnings recovery is a FY29 story. Working-capital absorption keeps the balance sheet stretched.
points: Ex-insurance EBITDA $469mn ($510/t); $547mn adding back $78mn tariff
Net debt $8.5bn vs $6.7bn at Mar-26
$1bn working capital used in 1HFY27; $300mn release guided in 2H
FY27/28/29 EBITDA kept at $1.9bn/$2.0bn/$2.3bn
Bay Minette 50-60% utilisation by FY28-end

bullets.text: MS: domestic HRC at Rs63.5K/t sits ~7% above import parity, limiting near-term upside, but safeguard duty keeps spreads supported; Industry View In-Line.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Materials: India Steel Tracker

detail.summary: Steel prices are stable and already at a premium to import parity, so MS sees little further price upside near term. The safeguard duty and seasonally strong demand support spreads, and MS expects steel stocks to keep outperforming over the next few months.

bullets.text: Ramco 2QFY27 EBITDA beat on realisations; Kotak holds SELL, FV Rs740 (from Rs730) on rollover, FY28-29E EBITDA cut 2-3% on south competition.
bullets.source: Kotak — [Kotak] The Ramco Cements (CMP: Rs812, FV: Rs740, SELL): Margin-led beat

detail.summary: Ramco's beat came from better south trade prices, while costs rose on operating deleverage and energy. Kotak expects cost inflation to outrun price hikes near term and sees greater competition in the south. It stays SELL on regional concentration and a 14X FY27E EV/EBITDA multiple.
points: EBITDA Rs660/t, flat qoq, -23% yoy; peers fell ~Rs180/t qoq
Volumes 4.9mt, +8.7% yoy; realisation Rs4,981/t, +1.1% qoq
Fuel Rs1.99/Mcal, +8% qoq; TN mineral tax Rs77/t hit in 1H
EBITDA/t Rs757/931/1,000 for FY27/28/29E; FV on 8X EV/EBITDA
Capacity +0.7mtpa; ~31mtpa target by Mar 2027, capex Rs8bn

bullets.text: ECMS sixth tranche approves 12 projects, Rs75bn outlay; cumulative approvals Rs770bn exceed the Rs593bn target; bare PCB and camera/display incentives are the upside.
bullets.source: JPMorgan — Hi Rajvaibhav, India EMS: ECMS: Sixth tranche announced

detail.summary: Government approved a sixth batch of 12 ECMS projects covering multi-layer PCB, relays, heat sinks, copper foil and materials. Most approved projects sit in JPM's coverage universe. Focus now shifts to turnover-linked incentives for bare PCB and camera/display modules, not fully in JPM or Street estimates.
points: 12 projects, Rs75bn investment outlay
Production worth Rs390bn, 7,127 direct jobs
Cumulative approvals Rs770bn vs Rs593bn scheme target
Fifth batch was 31 projects, Rs68bn, mid-Aug-26
Incentive details for bare PCB, camera, display could lift earnings

bullets.text: Centre may prioritise ECMS approvals for chip-supply-chain parts: micro-tools, CNC machines, PCB drills, automation equipment; a plan per officials, not notified policy.
bullets.source: Nomura — India Consumer Durables and EMS: Centre planning to use component scheme to feed chip ecosystem

detail.summary: ET reports the government may prioritise ECMS investment approvals for companies making parts linked to India's semiconductor supply chain, so local suppliers can integrate with domestic chip packaging and cut import dependence. Nomura flags this is officials' plan, not a notified change.
points: Focus: micro-tools, CNC machines, PCB drills, industrial automation
Sixth ECMS tranche due Friday (since announced)
Aim: link local suppliers to chip packaging units
Described by officials; not notified policy

bullets.text: Mphasis raised FY27 growth guide to low double digits CC; targets lifted to Rs2,800 (Emkay, ADD), Rs2,900 (BofA Buy, MS OW).
bullets.source: Emkay — Mphasis: Strong quarter; FY27 guidance narrowed upward; ADD; Target: Rs2,800 + others

detail.summary: Guidance moved from high single digit-to-low double digit to low double digit CC, backed by deal wins and backlog conversion. Houses lifted target multiples (Emkay 22x, BofA 23x FY28E) and nudged EPS up 1-4%. Emkay CMP was Rs2,529.
points: Emkay TP Rs2,800 from Rs2,500, ADD, 22x Sep-28E EPS
BofA PO Rs2,900 from Rs2,550, Buy, 23x FY28E EPS
MS PT Rs2,900 from Rs2,730, OW
EPS up 1-4% Emkay, 2-3% BofA, 1-4% MS

bullets.text: Mphasis 2Q: revenue +3.3% CC, EBITM flat at 14.8%, TCV $466mn (66% AI-led); small-deal wins +26% YoY shorten conversion.
bullets.source: BofA — MPHL IN: Mphasis: Short-cycle acceleration strengthens growth visibility; reiterate Buy + Emkay

detail.summary: Growth and deal intake were in line to strong, with short-cycle deals and a pipeline up 23% YoY lifting H2 visibility. Margins stayed inside the 14.75-15.75% guide as Tria and talent investments continue.
points: Revenue +3.3% QoQ CC; EBITM 14.8%
TCV $466mn; Emkay: 66% AI-led, five large deals
Small deal wins +26% YoY; their pipeline +35%
TMT +9.9% QoQ CC, BFS +4.4%; Logistics -11.9%

bullets.text: Cash is the soft spot: Mphasis OCF was negative Rs548mn in 2Q; MS sees FY27 conversion short of ~80% guide, margin at lower end.
bullets.source: Emkay — Mphasis: Strong quarter; FY27 guidance narrowed upward; ADD; Target: Rs2,800 + MS

detail.summary: Emkay flags weak cash conversion and a higher tax rate in its estimates. Morgan Stanley expects FY27 EBIT margin of 14.8%, toward the low end of the band, with margin and cash normalising in FY28.
points: 2Q OCF -Rs548mn (Emkay)
FY27 OCF target ~80% of net income; MS expects shortfall
MS FY27 EBIT margin 14.8%, FY28 15.1%
MS: FX hedge loss to ease over coming quarters

bullets.text: Record US$4.1bn FII equity inflow lifted Nifty 8.6% WoW while DIIs turned net sellers; Bull-Bear Index jumped to 82.9% from 42.2%.

DIIs sold US$1.9bn in November to date
INR +1.1% to 93.8/USD, six-month high
10-yr yield -23bps to 7.2%; Nifty fwd PE 18.3x
Realty best sector, IT laggard
